description:
In append.rs lines 112-127, parent existence is checked with one has_entry() call per parent CID — each is a separate DB round-trip. In normal CRDT operation this is 1–2 round-trips per append and is fine. However, for a 1000-article rnews batch, each article with 2 parents = 2000 individual SELECT queries just for parent-existence checks, executed serially inside the per-article pipeline.

The same logic applies in verify.rs verify_entry(): each parent triggers one storage.get_entry() call.

Fix: add a batch variant to LogStorage — `has_entries(ids: &[LogEntryId]) -> Result<Vec<bool>, StorageError>` implemented as a single `SELECT id FROM log_entries WHERE id IN (...)` query — and use it in append() and verify_entry(). The append() hot path (parent check + insert + tip advance) could be collapsed further into a single stored procedure or a single multi-statement transaction, but the batch SELECT is the minimum viable improvement.
notes: Pre-existing: N has_entry round-trips predates UUCP work. Deferring.
title: pipeline: N individual has_entry DB round-trips for parent CID checks per append
